title: Two Sum
description: Given an integer array nums and an integer target, return the indices of two distinct elements whose values add to target. Assume exactly one valid answer.
expected_time_complexity: O(n) expected with a hash map
editorial_summary: Track previously seen values in a hash map and look up target - current value.
source_type: original demonstration problem; verify before publishing

title: Count SQL Orders
description: Given an orders table with order_id and customer_id, write a query that returns the number of orders per customer, sorted by customer_id.
expected_output: SELECT customer_id, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM orders GROUP BY customer_id ORDER BY customer_id;

starter_code.sql:
SELECT customer_id, COUNT(*) AS order_count
FROM orders
GROUP BY customer_id
ORDER BY customer_id;

editorial_summary: Group rows by customer_id and aggregate with COUNT(*).
source_type: original demonstration problem; verify before publishing
